nodes.name: proto
nodes.script:
:: Make sure /protos is empty
if exist "{NODE_DIR}\protos" (
  rmdir /Q /S "{NODE_DIR}\protos"
)
mkdir "{NODE_DIR}\protos"

copy /y "{HMMLIST}" "{NODE_DIR}\"

:: Create prototype HMM
perl "{SHARED_DIR/scripts/MakeProtoHMMSet}" "{PROTO_CONF}"

:: Fix prototype names

if not exist "{NODE_DIR}\protos\a" (
  echo Prototypes failed to create!
  exit /b 1
)
copy /y "{NODE_DIR}\protos\a" "{NODE_DIR}\proto"

command_sets.name: HInit
command_sets.body:
# All this just to convert from an HTKGraph compliant name
# Into an HTK compliant name

  rm -rd {NODE_DIR}/protos
fi
mkdir -p {NODE_DIR}/protos

cp {PROTO} {NODE_DIR}/protos/

python {SHARED_DIR/scripts/fixprotonames.py} {NODE_DIR}/protos

nodename=$(ls protos/*)

for phone in $(cat {HMMLIST}); do

    -C {CONFIG} \

    -M {NODE_DIR}/init \

test_sets.name: HVite test
PHVite test
test_sets.body:
echo 'To change Core Count, Set Project Settings -> Run Environment -> PHVITE_CORE_COUNT'

# Set this to enable Phoneme Stats
phstat={@PHVITE_PHONEME_STATS}
# Set this to a numeric value to set the minimum requirement for
# occurances for confusion calculation
minocc={@PHVITE_MIN_OCCUR_STATS}

if [ -z "$phstat" ]; then echo 'PHVITE_PHONEME_STATS not set'; fi
if [ -z "$minocc" ]; then echo 'PHVITE_MIN_OCCUR_STATS not set'; fi

echo ''

cores=${PHVITE_CORE_COUNT:-4}

python {SHARED_DIR/bin/PHVite.py} -j $cores -A -D -T 1 \
    -C {TEST_CONFIG} \
    -H {MACROS_FILE} \
    -H {HMMDEFS} \
    -S {TEST_SCP} \
    -i recout.mlf \
    -w {WORDNET} \
    {DICT} {HMMLIST}

HResults -s -A -D \
    -I {MLF} \
    ${phstat:+-p} \
    {HMMLIST} recout.mlf > result.txt

python {SHARED_DIR/scripts/test/parsehtkresults.py} \
    ${minocc:+-n $minocc} \
    result.txt {o}

echo 'Done!'

test_sets.name: HLRescore
test_sets.body:
echo 'To change Core Count, Set Project Settings -> Run Environment -> PHVITE_CORE_COUNT'
cores=${PHVITE_CORE_COUNT:-4}

python {SHARED_DIR/bin/PHVite.py} -j $cores -A -D -T 1 \

    -H "{HMMDEFS}" \
    -S "{TEST_SCP}" \
    -l "{NODE_DIR}\lattice" \  # lattice dir
    -i recout.mlf \
    -w "{WORDNET}" \
    -p 0.0 -s 1.0 \
    -z lat \  # lattice file extension
    -n 32 \  # 32 tokens per state
    "{DICT}" "{HMMLIST}"

(cd "{SHARED_DIR/data}" && ls mfc/*.mfc | xargs -I {} echo "$(pwd)/{}" ) > lattice.scp

for s in 8.0 10.0 12.0 14.0; do
  for p in -20.0 -10.0 0.0 10.0; do
    HLRescore -A -D -T 1 \
      -C "{TEST_CONFIG}" \
      -S "{LATTICE_SCP}" \
      -i "rescored_s${s}_p${p}.mlf" \
      -s ${s} -p ${p} \
      -t 200.0 \
      "{DICT}"

    HResults -A -D -T 1 \
      -I "{REF_MLF}" \
      -e "???" sil \
      -e "???" sp \
      "{WORDLIST}" \
      "rescored_s${s}_p${p}.mlf"
  done
done
